goal: Create the production application graph and real async frontend port adapters, then wire them into MainActivity and AppShell without reverting existing UI work.
non_goals: Do not modify Room schema, provider protocol parsers, or Python APIs.
Do not rewrite existing visual screens.
Do not use GlobalScope or production runBlocking.
Do not commit unrelated pre-existing UI changes.
acceptance_criteria: Production factories use real repository/coordinator adapters instead of Fake ports.
Session model changes persist through the domain repository.
Workspace gesture locks receive actual UI events.
Coroutines are lifecycle-owned or explicitly closed.
App and feature tests, lint, and debug build pass.
verification_expectations: Run app and feature JVM tests.
List any mixed dirty files that cannot be committed independently.
